authority: Max, 2026-11-12 02:09 and 02:16 UTC: launch Gen 7 in the arena with the mix as discussed; standard is margin 0.25, trust 0.3, `path` 0.5, 3 tricks. Phase 1 is open. Phase 2 is not: it waits for phase 1 and for the self-play runtime to carry the gen7 engine.

labels.7f-32: Gen 7 fast (32): play weights and net tie-break, no tree
labels.7s-32: Gen 7 standard (32): fast plus the tree at tricks 3 to 6

halves.note: The same five pairs as two plans, for a fleet where only some machines have BEN servers. Either way every pair runs to 2,000 boards.

audits.7f-32~7f-32: as the cohort (tie audits, gap forks)
audits.7s-32~7s-32: as the cohort, with tree audits (`tree_audit` true)
audits.7s-32~6-32: as the cohort, with tree audits
audits.anchors: BEN boards have none (`ben_audit`). 5RZ32 and 1 boards carry the cohort's audits: there is no per-pair switch. Max allows audits off in any anchor pair.

notes: Phase 1 may be prepared and run from the three phase 1 plan files. Phase 2 may not.
Old data and scores are untouched. A Gen 7 cohort is a new immutable cohort with new source and run identities, as every cutover is.
Machines that prepare from the same source run pass their own --shard K/N to ops/prepare_gen7_alpha.py.
open_for_phase2: every phase 1 pair at 2,000 completed boards
